title: An empty side is not filled from the customer at invoicing
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have two active staff members at the test location with their "Sales Representative" switch on: sales rep A and sales rep B.
  • Use a customer whose one Sales Representative is sales rep B.
  • Have a work order for that customer with one labor line and one part, "Sales Representative - Labor" reading "Unassigned" and "Sales Representative - Parts" set to sales rep A, and invoice it today.
  • Make sure sales rep B has no other invoices at the test location today, so the report would list sales rep B only if this invoice credited them.
  • Open Reports > Sales By Representative in a desktop browser at least 1024 pixels wide, with the date range set to today, Show Unassigned on and the Sales Type column turned on.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The labor of the work order's invoice is credited to Unassigned on a "Labor" row.

Step 2:

  • The part is credited to sales rep A on a "Parts" row.
  • Sales rep B is not listed in the report: nothing is credited to sales rep B.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11266 (Story 2, Give a work order a separate Labor and Parts representative), story SV-11268 (Story 4, Give a customer default representatives), story SV-11269 (Story 5, Credit each side on the invoice and in Sales By Representative)

  • S4-N1: “A work order with a representative on either side does not use the customer's representatives, even for the empty side (S2-N1).”
  • S2-N1: “A side is never refilled on its own. Setting one side to "Unassigned" never hands that side to the other person and never fills it from the customer after the work order is created (S4-R24, S4-R28).”
  • S5-R18: “A side with no representative is credited to Unassigned, which shows when Show Unassigned is on, as today.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
